v2_2_audit.physical_ground_truth_note: No physical measurements of the filming location are available. Distance validation (Phases 3-4, 9) cannot be performed against real-world ground truth.

detection.cabin_suppression: Persons whose centroid falls inside a forklift bounding box are suppressed to prevent operator false detections.
detection.known_limitation: Low confidence threshold (0.08) increases recall but risks more false positives.

tracking.id_assignment: ByteTrack assigns integer Track IDs via IoU matching + re-identification. IDs persist across frames via the `persist=True` flag.
tracking.missing_detection_handling: EventEngine tolerates up to max_gap_frames=15 consecutive missed frames before closing an event. ByteTrack itself has internal lost-track buffer.
tracking.id_switch_risk: When tracking is lost for >15 frames, a new ID is assigned on re-detection, causing fragmentation.
tracking.known_limitation: No manual Track ID to physical identity mapping. Fallback IDs are anonymous integers.

ground_plane_homography.calibration_type: Manual 4-point homography (src_pts hardcoded to video-specific coordinates)
ground_plane_homography.critical_limitation: src_pts are HARDCODED estimates, NOT verified against physical measurements. The 3.5m x 6.0m world space is an ASSUMPTION, not a measured ground truth.
ground_plane_homography.physical_validation_status: NOT VALIDATED — No physical measurements available

footprint_extraction.method: Bottom-center of bounding box (cx, y2) is used as ground contact point
footprint_extraction.known_limitation: Does not account for perspective foreshortening, object height, or camera angle. For tall objects (forklifts), the foot point may be significantly offset from true ground contact.

distance_calculation.method: Euclidean distance in world coordinates after homography projection
distance_calculation.validity_check: Both footpoints must be within calibrated bounds (src_pts ± 100px margin)
distance_calculation.physical_validation_status: NOT VALIDATED — Homography parameters unverified against physical measurements

trajectory.velocity_smoothing: Rolling window of smoothing_window=5 points to suppress jitter
trajectory.known_limitation: Smoothing may mask sudden direction changes in real scenarios

ttc_calculation.approach_velocity: Dot product of relative velocity vector with normalized position vector
ttc_calculation.physical_validation_status: ALGORITHMICALLY VALIDATED — No real-world ground truth for relative motion available

interaction_event.creation_trigger: Any frame where distance_m < calibration max AND calibration_status=VALID
interaction_event.continuation_logic: Event continues if same P-F pair seen within max_gap_frames=15 frames
interaction_event.known_limitation: Only person-forklift pairs generate events. Person-person or forklift-forklift interactions are ignored.

components.distance_risk: exp(-scale * min_dist) + exp(-scale * median_dist) with configurable weights
components.duration_risk: base_weight * duration + caution_multiplier * time_in_caution + danger_multiplier * time_in_danger

risk_exposure.known_limitation: Weights are PROJECT-DEFINED, not derived from industrial safety standards or empirical data.

evidence_engine.critical_note: High YOLO detection confidence does NOT influence Evidence Level. Only data completeness and structural quality matter.

identified_gaps: Homography src_pts are hardcoded estimates — NOT physically measured
World space dimensions (3.5m x 6.0m) are assumed, not verified
